sentences.text: Malarguesaurus is classified as a titanosaurian sauropod dinosaur, a group of large, robust quadrupedal herbivores.
Its tail features anterior and middle vertebrae of the procero-opisthoplatic type, linked to posterior procercal caudal vertebrae.
This animal likely reached an impressive length of 18 meters and a weight of 20 tonnes.
Fossils were discovered in the Portezuelo Formation of the Neuquén Group in Argentina. The type species Malarguesaurus florenciae was described by González Riga and colleagues in 2008.
Malarguesaurus lived during the Late Cretaceous, approximately 89 million years ago, between the Turonian and Coniacian stages. The fossil record spans from 89.8 to 85.7 million years ago.
Research by Mannion et al. in 2013 more precisely recovered Malarguesaurus as a member of the subclade Somphospondyli.
